Definition: To return, turn back and repent — turning away from sin and returning home to God.
BiblicalUsage: Shuv is the prophets' great call: 'Return to the Lord your God, for you have stumbled.' It pictures repentance as a homecoming journey, and God promises that when Israel returns, He restores.
TheologicalSignificance: Shuv means no one has wandered too far to come home. Repentance is not grovelling — it is turning toward a Father who says, 'Return to Me, and I will return to you.'
